source.name: AFC - NEOM and AFC announce global multi-year partnership extension
source.note: Official Global Partner of AFC national-team and club competitions, 2024-2029, after an initial four-year deal.

note: Top-tier AFC global partner. NEOM is a wholly PIF-owned Saudi giga-project; the same release made NEOM Presenting Partner of the ACL Elite Final Stage and the AFC Women's Champions League.
